The '''Oppressor-7 class dark trooper''' was a [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] variant used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Typically stationed as [[City/Legends|city]] guards along with the [[Glory-class dark trooper]], the Oppressor-7 class saw a wide range of use on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as law enforcement agents.

==Equipment==
Armaments used by the Oppressor-7 Class include [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbines]], standard-issue [[E-11 carbine]]s, [[Stun/Legends|stun]] batons, and sometimes heavy [[DXR-6b disruptor rifle]]s. Sleek [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] installed on the back of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] helped with escaping tight situations and providing extra maneuverability.

==Other==
Although considered more advanced, the Oppressor-7 had a similar appearance to the [[Exogen-class dark trooper]].
